topics.topic: India at World Border Security Congress 2026
topics.why_in_news: India participated in World Border Security Congress 2026 highlighting smart border management, integrated surveillance systems and technology-driven border security reforms.
prelims_quick_notes: Border security important component of national security.
India emphasised technology-driven smart border management.
Integrated border management includes surveillance, coordination and infrastructure.
Use of drones, AI and sensors increasing in border security.
Comprehensive Integrated Border Management System (CIBMS) supports surveillance.
India has diverse land and maritime borders.
Smart fencing projects implemented along sensitive borders.
Border security linked with counter-terrorism and anti-smuggling operations.
important_facts: BSF guards India–Pakistan and India–Bangladesh borders.
SSB guards India–Nepal and India–Bhutan borders.
Assam Rifles primarily guards India–Myanmar border.
CIBMS integrates sensors, radars and communication technologies.
Border Roads Organisation supports strategic border infrastructure.
key_highlights: India showcased smart surveillance and border technologies.
Focus on AI-enabled and data-driven border management.
Cross-border crime and infiltration challenges discussed.
International cooperation in border security highlighted.
exam_relevance: Important for Internal Security, Border Management and Defence.
Useful for smart surveillance and technology governance topics.
Can be linked with cybersecurity, AI and national security.
prelims_traps: Different border forces guard different frontiers.
CIBMS relates to integrated smart border management.
BSF does not guard India–China border.
Assam Rifles primarily associated with India–Myanmar border.
